texts.preamble: Dhananjay Kumar Pandey vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others on 27 November, 2024 Author: Sujit Narayan Prasad Bench: Sujit Narayan Prasad, Navneet Kumar In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi W.P.(Cr.) (Db) (Hb) No.460 of 2024 ----- Dhananjay Kumar Pandey ... ... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand & Others ... ... Respondents ------- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar ------- For the Petitioner : Mr. Nawal Kishor Pandey, Advocate For the State : Mr. Deepankar Roy, Ac to G.A.-Iii For the Resp. No.6 : Mr. Anand Kumar Sinha, Advocate ------ th Order No. 06/Dated 27 November, 2024 1. The writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking following directions :- a. Issuance of appropriate writ(s) order(s) / direction(s) in nature of Habeas Corpus for direction upon the respondents to immediately produce "X", wife of Dhananjay Kumar Pandey (petitioner) aged about 24 years (now in custody of Ayodhya Singh Chouhan) against her will, before this Hon'ble Court.
texts.facts: After solemnization of their marriage on 30.04.2024, the petitioner and his wife have telephonically contacted to their family on 01.05.2024 for giving information of marriage then the petitioner got information that the father and the family members of the girl are giving threatening to the father and other family members of the petitioner. It is the further case of the petitioner that the family of the petitioner was under heavy pressure and threat by the illegal activities of the father of the girl and the local police have also indulged with them and pressurized the family of the petitioner to bring back both the petitioner and the girl. The petitioner also Dhananjay Kumar Pandey vs The State Of Jharkhand & Others on 27 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105646308/ 2 approached to the Superintendent of Police, Dhanbad and the Senior Superintendent of Police Dhanbad and made representation but no action has been taken till date. 6. We direct the Senior Superintendent of Police Dhanbad to initiate an enquiry and submit a report to this Court in a sealed cover about the allegation of torture, threat and threat perception upon the petitioner and his parents or other family members from the side of family members of the corpus. 7. It is made clear that the Senior Superintendent of Police, Dhanbad, will make the parents of the girl understand that if any untowards incident happens to the girl or any of the family members of the petitioner, they will be primarily held responsible. The writ petition since has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for restoration of Habeas Corpus and as such considering the statements so recorded in order dated 01.08.2024 of the parents, as taken note by the co-ordinate Bench in paragraph No.3, wherein the parents have stated that it is the question of their honor as they belong to a different caste than that of the boy.

Similarly, in petitions seeking police protection from the natal family of the parties, the family must not be placed in the same environment as the petitioners; f.
Upon securing the environment and inviting the detained or missing person in chambers, the court must make active efforts to put the detained or missing person at ease.
The preferred name and pronouns of the detained or missing person may be asked.
The person must be given a comfortable seating, access to drinking water and washroom.
They must be allowed to take periodic breaks to collect themselves.
The judge must adopt a friendly and compassionate demeanor and make all efforts to defuse any tension or discomfort.

Courts must ensure that the detained or missing person faces no obstacles in being able to express their wishes to the court;
